narratives.body: Chelsea FC Latest News .com reports that the club promoted Penders and Sharman-Lowe following Emi Martinez's injury. The headline states the promotion occurred after Martinez's injury.
narratives.headline: Chelsea promote Penders and Sharman-Lowe after Martinez injury

narratives.body: Talk Chelsea notes that Chelsea's £100m target could yet sign a new contract, claims his boss. The headline quotes the boss saying, 'We haven't given up'.
narratives.headline: Chelsea's £100m target could sign new contract claims boss

narratives.body: London Evening Standard provides an injury update listing Martinez, Chavarria, and James with latest return dates. Flashscore.com adds that Chelsea are searching for new right-back options amid Gusto uncertainty.
narratives.headline: Chelsea injury updates and right-back search
